title: Nominal payment-volume definition and scope
locator: Item 7, Key Business Drivers, definitions and volume footnotes, pages 42-43
publication: 2024-11-13, SEC filing accepted 17:14:01 (index does not label timezone)
redistribution: Factual table amounts, headings and concise source definitions only. Full issuer documents remain private and are not redistributed.
text: Payments volume is the aggregate dollar amount of purchases made with Visa-branded cards and other form factors, and excludes Europe co-badged volume. Nominal payments volume is denominated in U.S. dollars using Visa-established exchange rates applied to local-currency volume reported by clients. Visa notes some tables may not recalculate exactly because of rounding.
